summary: Official warnings state that people taking Vemurafenib need skin checks before, during, and up to six months after treatment because new skin cancers, known as cutaneous malignancies, can form [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, gave this drug a high risk score for liver issues and a low risk score for heart issues [M]. Multiple clinical studies testing combinations with this drug were stopped early due to high toxicities and side effects that limited the doses patients could take [5][6][7].
